## Austin’s source-confirmed fact-check

Every figure in How Our Data Works, including the D1–D15 decision log, was checked against main at commit 231281b (data-v0.6) on November 16; the score figures, the test count and the rows marked November 17 were rechecked against main at 4145dfa (scoring v0.4) on November 17.

| Figure | Value | How checked |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Tests | 297 passed | Ran: pytest on main at 4145dfa, November 17, Python 3.13.18 with the pinned packages |
| Data checks | 167 passed, 0 failed, 16 warnings | Ran: the checks on the committed tables, without rewriting the report; rerun on 4145dfa on November 17 with the same result |
| The 16 warnings | 13 mostly empty columns, 3 bank-ID groups | Ran: the same run |
| Releases | Six, data-v0.1 to data-v0.6 | Read: the repo's tags |
| Download log | 706 files | Ran: counted `data/manifest.csv` |
| Table sizes | `msa_year` 3,930 × 58; `msa_year_history` 1,965 × 5; `msa_naics_year` 67,487 × 7; `bank_msa_year` 331,879 × 21; `bank_quarter` 240,330 × 62 (47.5 MB) | Ran: opened each Parquet file |
| Counties and metros | 1,252 counties in 393 metros | Ran: counted the crosswalk |
| Ranks | 190 ranked; 381 complete, 191 of them under 250,000; 6 partial; Puerto Rico's 6 not scored; Charlotte 19th | Ran: `python -m src.scoring.run` on main at 4145dfa, November 17, which reproduces the committed scores; with the old blank rule the same code reproduces the pre-#128 scores (176 ranked, Charlotte 17th) |
| Industry sectors missing | 95 metros (mining 69, agriculture 25, utilities 11, management of companies 4); the sectors left out hold at most 1.02% of a metro's jobs (median 0.07%) | Ran: `msa_naics_year` for 2023 against `msa_year`'s all-industry totals, November 17 |
| Charlotte deposits, 2024 | $457.3 billion; 84% at main offices; 99.7% of those at Bank of America and Truist | Ran: `msa_year` and `bank_msa_year`; within 0.1% of FDIC's figure (spot check) |
| Charlotte concentration, 2024 | HHI 5,391 against 1,975; top three 94% against 62% | Ran: `msa_year` |
| Home-banking offices | San Antonio 2024: 991, or 3,713 with main offices alone left out; 629 metro-years change | 991 ran from `msa_year`; 3,713 and 629 read from the data dictionary |
